question: With two observations per candidate order, do new-fixture claim-link batches retain quality and remain below matched direct input and completion cost?

call_budget.reset_credits: do not consume without explicit operator approval

confirmation_thresholds.quality: all four fresh candidate critiques have every expected claim status, expected verdict, same-claim finding links, and zero unlinked findings
confirmation_thresholds.order_check: each order has two quality-passing observations when its prior batch is included

interpretation_limits: The earlier observation in each order predates this replication plan and must remain identified separately.
Two observations per order support a bounded replication result, not a universal latency distribution.
Keep batch size two and do not generalize to mutable, dependent, or mixed-policy work.
stop_rules: Run exactly one scheduled cell per invocation and never retry automatically.
Commit every attempted cell before starting another.
Stop after any excluded run, structured quality failure, provider drift, or current-window usage at or above 60 percent.
Do not edit candidate orders, prompt hashes, baselines, or thresholds after the first live call.
